name: neuromorphic-computing
description: Use this skill when the user says 'neuromorphic', 'spiking neural network', 'SNN', 'LIF neuron', 'Loihi', 'SpiNNaker', 'event camera', 'surrogate gradient', 'snnTorch', 'Lava framework', 'memristor in-memory computing'. Explains event-driven spiking computation, neuron models, training methods (surrogate gradients, ANN-to-SNN conversion), hardware platforms, and when neuromorphic approaches are worth prototyping. Do NOT use for: conventional GPU deep learning (ml/deep-learning), edge inference on MCUs with standard networks (embedded-systems/edge-ai), or quantum hardware (quantum-computing/*).
